en.description:
Strap in, pilot — the galaxy fits on your wrist!

Asteroids for Apple Watch brings back that perfect arcade chaos in a totally new way. Twist the Digital Crown to rotate your ship with precision, tap the screen to fire your thrusters, and dodge those spinning space rocks as you drift endlessly through the void.

Every movement feels sharp and tactile. The crown gives you full analog control, just like the old arcade spinner. Touch to boost, coast to conserve momentum, and blast asteroids into shimmering fragments that scatter across your tiny universe.

The sound effects pop right off your wrist, crunchy explosions, blaster zaps, and the low hum of your ship’s engines make every encounter feel alive. 

On the start screen, a long press opens your Settings Console, where you can tweak sound and vibration.

It’s simple, fast, and ridiculously addictive.

Each round feels different — sometimes you’ll thread between massive asteroids with a perfect drift, other times you’ll explode into space dust in seconds. But you’ll always want to try one more run.

Old-school arcade fun, reinvented for Apple Watch.

No fluff. Just you, your ship, and the rocks.
